messages:
Anne (Partnerships): quick sync — CloudHub listing for CloudEdge hardware partner needs SOC2 Type II report + external pen test report + signed attestation from HSM vendor by 2026-04-10. who's owning each artifact? 
Sam (Security): @Anne (Partnerships) I'm happy to own the pen-test intake. need scope confirm — do we require full exploit details or redacted findings? :thinking:
Anne (Partnerships): prefer redacted findings + remediation plan. we need proof of fixes for high/critical. full logs can be shared to SRE under NDA. 
Mohit (Eng): from HW side, we also need firmware attestation & HSM key provenance. @devops-bot can we request presigned uploads with server-side-encryption=AES256 and kms-key-id tag? 
devops-bot: presign template generated — see link: https://s3-presign.example.com/abcd
Lisa (Legal): confirm NDAs for SIs and HW vendor are in place before sharing. also recommend 90-day TTL on presigned links. 
Sam (Security): scope question: include internal cloud infra pen-test or just listing surface + SI connectors? I recommend both minimal: marketplace endpoints + SI integrations. full infra optional. 
Anne (Partnerships): for go/no-go gating for joint announcement: we require SOC2 Type II audit letter, pen-test summary (redacted), HSM attestation, and signed marketplace questionnaire. can we get all by 2026-04-10? 
Mohit (Eng): timeline looks tight. firmware attestation from HW vendor needs their security team sign-off — I'll ping their PM. 
Sam (Security): I'll draft intake email to the pen-testing firm with scope: "marketplace API endpoints, SI OAuth flows, S3 presign flow". will add requirement for CVE remediation status. 
Lisa (Legal): on redaction: we accept redacted PoC and vuln traces if they remove PII and customer IPs. require attestations that redaction was done by the vendor/tester. 
Anne (Partnerships): owner map: pen test -> Sam, SOC artifacts -> Anne (we'll collect vendor audit letter), HSM attestation -> Mohit, legal attest/nda -> Lisa. please confirm by EOD. :calendar:
Mohit (Eng): confirmed. I'll also provide a small checksum manifest for each artifact: filename + sha256 + owner email. 
Sam (Security): confirmed. I'll circulate pen-test intake + a short rubric for acceptable redaction. 
Lisa (Legal): confirmed. I'll circulate NDA template and minimal data sharing clause. 
Anne (Partnerships): thanks all. next steps: Sam sends intake today, Mohit chases vendor, Lisa sends NDA, I'll update the announcement hold sheet. ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
